title: Tangling Hairbrush

observedRule.sourceText: Each brush stroke creates a new knot, and the knots tighten the more you brush; hair eventually coils around the brush like a topiary.

observedPayoff.sourceText: The hair regrows instantly into a larger, tighter knot, trapping the scissors.

inference: The stated brush rule creates and tightens knots; the payoff additionally makes cut hair regrow instantly. This may introduce a new mechanism rather than derive the ending from knotting.
limitation: Source-bound editorial concern, not an automatic verdict. Inspect middle beats for an established causal bridge.

title: Self-Knotting Laces

observedRule.sourceText: As you tie a bow, the laces weave themselves into additional knots, becoming tighter and more complex with every pull; untying creates two new knots.

observedPayoff.sourceText: The knotted shoe follows him, hopping along, and the laces untie themselves into a perfect bow on the other shoe.

inference: The stated laces rule creates extra knots on tying or untying; the ending unties itself into a perfect bow on another shoe. Verify whether the intervening beats establish this exception.
limitation: Source-bound editorial concern, not an automatic verdict. Inspect middle beats for an established causal bridge.

title: Bending Nail Hammer

observedRule.sourceText: Every hammer strike causes the nail to bend away from the wall at a right angle; bending increases with force.

observedPayoff.sourceText: All nails in the room curve, pictures crash, and the original nail pings into Kiko's hand, bending his thumb comically.

inference: The rule concerns the nail struck by the hammer; the payoff extends bending to all room nails and the character thumb. This expands both target scope and physical behavior.
limitation: Source-bound editorial concern, not an automatic verdict. Inspect middle beats for an established causal bridge.

title: Opposite-Color Paintbrush

observedRule.sourceText: Whatever color you load, the brush deposits the complementary color; loading blue paints orange, loading red paints green.

observedPayoff.sourceText: The white paint turns black, then the entire wall flashes and becomes a mirror reflecting the room in inverted colors.

inference: Complementary paint colors are established; the wall becoming a mirror adds a material/reflection property not explicit in that rule.
limitation: Source-bound editorial concern, not an automatic verdict. Inspect middle beats for an established causal bridge.

title: Spiky Ice Cube Tray

observedRule.sourceText: The water freezes into sharp upward spikes that puncture the plastic tray and any covering, growing toward the ceiling.

observedPayoff.sourceText: The bag of ice starts sprouting spikes inside the plastic bag, and the bag floats up to the ceiling, freezing a chandelier.

inference: Upward-growing ice spikes are established; the final bag also floats. Verify whether this motion is physically caused by the spike growth or is a separate flight effect.
limitation: Source-bound editorial concern, not an automatic verdict. Inspect middle beats for an established causal bridge.

title: Delayed Mirror

observedRule.sourceText: The mirror shows a reflection delayed by one second, so Kiko sees her previous movement; when she moves to adjust, the lag causes her to misreach and bump herself.

observedPayoff.sourceText: The reflection catches up and then freezes, while Kiko's own image splits into two identical Kikos in the room.

inference: A one-second delayed reflection is established; physical duplication of the character at the ending is an additional effect.
limitation: Source-bound editorial concern, not an automatic verdict. Inspect middle beats for an established causal bridge.

title: Smearing Eraser

observedRule.sourceText: Rubbing eraser spreads graphite into a larger smudge, and the smudge darkens into a sticky tar that stains fingers and paper.

observedPayoff.sourceText: The smudge spreads to the opposite page, then shrinks into a perfect drawing of a cat, no longer a mistake.

inference: Graphite spreading into sticky tar is established; shrinking into a perfect cat drawing adds a new transformation. Rule linkage needs human creative review.
limitation: Source-bound editorial concern, not an automatic verdict. Inspect middle beats for an established causal bridge.
